auth_success_redirect_url.sh: URL the user is redirected to upon successful authentication

auth_url.sh: authentication URL the user must be redirected to in order to link their account

expires_in.sh: a number in seconds depicting how long the url is valid for

providers.sh: Comma separated list of providers to display on the device selection page.

reference_id.sh: Identifier of the end user on your system, such as a user ID or email associated with them

session_id.sh: Session ID for the widget authentication session

status.sh: indicates that the request was successful

url.sh: the widget URL the user must be redirected to in order to link their account

user_id.sh: User ID for the user being created

sdk_providers.sh: Providers available through Terra's mobile SDKs rather than cloud connections

collection_date.sh: Specimen collection date (YYYY-MM-DD); omitted if not extracted.

collection_time.sh: Specimen collection time (HH:MM, 24-hour); omitted if not extracted.

current_status.sh: Current status as a clean lowercase string (open enum), e.g.

panels.sh: Report-level panels that results reference by panel_id.

patient_age_at_collection.sh: Patient age in years; omitted if unknown.

patient_sex.sh: Clean lowercase string (open enum); omitted if unspecified.

reference_id.sh: Your external reference; omitted if not set.

report_date.sh: Date printed on the report (YYYY-MM-DD); omitted if not extracted.

report_time.sh: Time printed on the report (HH:MM, 24-hour); omitted if not extracted.

report_type.sh: Report type as a clean lowercase string (open enum — handle unknown values gracefully).

attempt_count.sh: Retry count — 0 on the first attempt, incremented per retry.

last_error.sh: Most recent delivery error; omitted when delivered.

coercion_warnings.sh: Set when the template could not be represented exactly on the provider.

details.sh: Full workout body (title, description, planned metrics, structured steps) fetched live from the provider.

is_external.sh: True when the workout was created on the provider side rather than through Terra.

planned_workout_id.sh: Terra identifier of the planned workout

provider_workout_id.sh: Identifier assigned by the provider, once pushed.

pool_length_meters.sh: Pool length in meters, for swim workouts

workout_id.sh: Terra identifier of the stored template.
